Two Minutes a Day: Why Habit-Sized Games Keep Working
items.en_title: Two Minutes a Day: Why Habit-Sized Games Keep Working
items.en_oneliner: Daily games compete for a short, repeatable slot in a player's day, and the author uses a daily word puzzle to unpack the design trade-offs of keeping that slot deliberately finite.
